title: BanzaRevocationList
description: The BANZA Revocation List (BRL) — the live revocation mechanism for the federation. Lists the published operator trust material currently suspended or revoked, keyed by the publishing operator_id — revocation targets the operator's published cryptographic/trust material, never the entity itself (ADR-027 D-038-06; certification suspension lives in the Layer-2 state machine, ADR-035). Signed by the BANZA revocation-domain delegated key (NOT the root key and NOT the protocol-metadata or conformance-evidence keys — ADR-027 domain separation). Operators MUST fetch a fresh BRL at least every 6 hours and MUST NOT route to any operator appearing in a valid, non-expired BRL (INV-FEDEVAL-002). Published at the canonical location https://banza.network/federation/revocation-list.json.
_source_of_truth: spec/canonicalization.md (signing/digest bytes); contracts/production/brl.production.schema.json (structure). Normative; not derived from any implementation.

schema_version.description: BRL schema version. Must be '1' for this format.

issuer.description: Always the literal string 'BANZA'. Any other value makes this BRL invalid.

issuer_key_id.description: Identifier of the BANZA revocation-domain delegated key that signed this BRL. Format 'banza-brl-YYYYMM'. The verifier resolves this key_id in the current Key Manifest (domain == 'revocation', status == 'active') to obtain the public key. A BRL signed by any non-revocation-domain key (e.g. a protocol-metadata key or the root key) MUST be rejected.

issued_at.description: UTC timestamp (ISO 8601) when this BRL was signed.

expires_at.description: UTC timestamp by which a fresh BRL MUST be fetched. ADR-027: routine cadence is at most 6 hours after issued_at; an emergency BRL may set 1 hour. A BRL past expires_at is stale and MUST trigger a refresh before any routing decision.

revoked.description: Entries of withdrawn operator trust material, keyed by the publishing operator_id. An empty array means no material is currently withdrawn. Routing to an implementation whose published material appears here MUST be rejected regardless of any other trust signal (INV-FEDEVAL-002). Revocation is a protocol security signal over published material — not a sanction, licence, authorisation or judgment about the entity.

operator_id.description: The stable BANZA operator_id whose published trust material is suspended or revoked. Same identifier form as the Operator Manifest operator_id; identifies the material's publisher, never sanctions the entity.

reason.description: 'suspended' — the material is temporarily withdrawn; lifted by removing the entry from the BRL. 'revoked' — the material is withdrawn indefinitely; interoperation resumes only by publishing fresh signed protocol metadata and conformance evidence that pass the Open Trust Evaluation (ADR-031). No party re-admits anyone.

permanent.description: true when reason == 'revoked' and the material withdrawal is permanent; false for a suspension.

since.description: UTC timestamp from which this suspension/revocation took effect.

signature.description: ed25519 signature by the BANZA revocation-domain issuing key over the canonical JSON of all other fields (keys sorted lexicographically, no whitespace, UTF-8, signature field excluded). Base64url-encoded, 86 chars for 64 bytes.
